svg.title: Kept NWS wind forecasts minus KPMV's reports
svg.desc: Histograms of forecast minus reported wind speed, gust and direction at three issuance leads, 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-22. Hours counted per bin; the dashed line is zero.
svg.text: Kept NWS forecasts minus KPMV's reports, 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-22
Hours per bin. Right of the dashed line the forecast was above the report, left of it below.
Rows: the newest issuance at least 0, 6 and 24 hours before the hour.
n 223 · median −1 kt · mean −0.8 kt · 56 above, 129 below
n 53 · median +3 kt · mean +3.5 kt · 45 above, 3 below
n 217 · median −1 kt · mean −0.7 kt · 52 above, 123 below
n 53 · median +3 kt · mean +4 kt · 50 above, 1 below
n 199 · median −1 kt · mean −1.2 kt · 33 above, 130 below
n 52 · median +3 kt · mean +4 kt · 46 above, 2 below
Speeds in whole knots, as a METAR reports. Direction only where the report gave one (not calm or variable). Source: docs/kept-forecasts-vs-kpmv.md, scripts/keptWindErrorsPlot.ts.
